item.title: Europe #4743 the Twice-Born was broken in the archipelago (brawl). The bones lie scattered
item.description: Europe #4743 the Twice-Born was broken in the archipelago (brawl). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.
